scope: every for/while/do loop (macro loops at their use site) in every function defined in the eight system-selection files, plus the slice's direct-call recursion cycles and the cross-invocation revisit sites read by hand
no_progress_verdict: Quirin proves resource safety, not progress. The quirin fields are the resource audit's status and reasons for the enclosing function; no progress verdict is computed or implied.

roles.callback: runs on the engine thread from a registered event: flush timer, collector, scheduler timer or request, output or input event
roles.ingestion: runs inside an input's append path (called from input collectors on the engine thread, or from the ring-buffer collector)
roles.shutdown: runs from the engine's STOP / grace-timer handling
roles.lifecycle: start-up, configuration or exit; runs once per start or stop
roles.no-caller: no caller found in src/ or plugins/ at the pin

classes.bounded: iterations bounded by a stated quantity fixed at loop entry, under the listed premises
classes.decreasing: a stated measure decreases strictly each iteration and is bounded below, under the listed premises
classes.yielding: a non-terminating service loop that blocks (yields) each round
classes.unresolved: no bound or measure holds without a premise that is not established (and, where marked, is violated under an injected fault)

premises.PL: the traversed list is a finite, well-formed mk_list/cfl_list and the body (callees included) does not insert into it; a _safe traversal removes at most the current node
premises.PC: the configuration's input and output instance lists are not modified while the engine runs
premises.PF: a callee in the body does not free the saved successor of a _safe traversal (P-ILI-CALLEE-FRAME)
premises.PW: at most one backlog wrapper per chunk per backlog queue (OB-3 of W45-FB-BACKLOG-CUSTODY)
premises.PR: no producer thread writes the ring buffer while it is drained
premises.PU: cio_chunk_up_force returns neither CIO_ERROR nor CIO_RETRY for a backlog queue head
premises.PRAND: 1 <= range <= RAND_MAX and rand() returns every value in [0, RAND_MAX] with positive probability
premises.PK: the macro constants hold their pinned values: FLB_ENGINE_LOOP_MAX_ITER = 10 (flb_engine_macros.h:61), FLB_ENGINE_OUTPUT_EVENT_BATCH_SIZE = 1 (flb_engine.h:29)
premises.PN: the loop's counter is not written in the body and its bound is not written in the body

expressible_as.measure-const: a checked measure: counter against a literal or macro constant, counter not written in the body
expressible_as.measure-var: a checked measure: counter against a local, parameter or field not written in the body
expressible_as.measure-u16: a checked measure: counter against a uint16_t count read from chunk metadata (<= 65535)
expressible_as.measure-shift: a checked measure: a non-negative integer strictly decreased by a right shift; needs PE as a precondition contract
expressible_as.list-contract: a bound over a list length: needs a contract premise that the list is finite and not extended by the body's callees (PL); not derivable locally
expressible_as.none: no measure exists without an unestablished premise
expressible_as.n/a: a service loop; a bound is not the property
expressible_as.once: a do { } while (0) macro body; executes exactly once
